description: Complete the CortexPlus connection with the short authentication key the user received by email after signup. Ask the user to paste the key, then call this tool; never guess or invent the key. The response includes an API key that the AI platform should save in its CortexPlus connector configuration.

client.description: The name of the AI platform you are running on, e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor.

key.description: The authentication key pasted by the user from their CortexPlus email.

name: connect
